note: Mole tasks. i is the task's permanent index (stored in each Mole's private doc); never renumber or reuse one. n is how many times it has to be done. The first 8 are v0.8's, unchanged.

tasks.text: Get three people to say “pineapple” before Sunday
Swap two things round in a shared space without anyone noticing
Borrow someone’s hoodie and wear it to the next plan
Get someone to high-five you for no reason
Work the word “flamingo” into three conversations
Get the circle to move a plan by five minutes
Leave a sticky note with a compliment where someone will find it
Start an argument about the best crisp flavour and stay out of it
Get three people to tell you the time without asking them for it
Get someone in the circle to sing a line of a song
Sit in a different seat from usual at every plan this week
Get the circle to take a group photo
Say “as my grandmother always says” twice, and make up the saying
Get someone to swap seats with you
Get two people to agree that mangoes are overrated
Borrow a pen and keep it until the end of the plan without anyone asking for it
Get someone to teach you a word in their language
Order exactly what the first person orders, at every meal this week
Get the circle to try a snack none of you has had before
Wear the same colour as someone in the circle without planning it openly
Get someone to send you a photo of their lunch
Slip the word “flabbergasted” into the circle chat twice
Get two people to recommend you the same film
Get the circle to take the long way somewhere
Make someone laugh using only a facial expression
Get two other people to high-five each other
Persuade someone to try a new chai or coffee order
Use someone’s favourite emoji back at them three times
Leave a doodle on a napkin or sticky note where the circle will find it
Get the circle to plan next week’s outing without suggesting it yourself
